scope.behavior: clean promoter classifier enrichment: margin(true GENCODE MANE TSS)-margin(composition-matched same-locus pseudo-TSS)
scope.licensed_if_qualified: head-level candidate localization and candidate-set CLS mediation of the clean supervised promoter behavior

frozen_basis.threshold_basis: The reserved 16-pair GUE calibration produced attribution/exact-patch Spearman 0.839/0.787, exact no-op effect 0, batch drift 4.77e-7, and candidate-group effects 4.87/5.28 logits. Projecting its observed pair variability to 192 loci gives 80% MDE 0.504/0.562, below the frozen +0.60 group SESOI. No GENCODE internal outcome was read.

cohort.source: GENCODE v50 protein-coding MANE Select TSS cohort from promoter-classifier-v2
cohort.selection: lowest SHA-256 ranks over example_id after one-row-per-locus filtering

measurement.head_node: one attention context slice before the shared output projection
measurement.necessity_patch: target CLS head context <- paired pseudo-TSS CLS head context; native target margin minus patched target margin
measurement.sufficiency_patch: pseudo-TSS CLS head context <- paired target CLS head context; patched control margin minus native control margin

candidate_selection.eligibility: positive development mean for exact necessity, exact sufficiency, necessity attribution, and sufficiency attribution
candidate_selection.ranking: ascending mean fractional rank across the same four measurements

group_validation.multiple_testing: Holm across candidate-set necessity and sufficiency
group_validation.random_set_inference: one-sided add-one rank against distinct layer-profile-matched set means

individual_head_reporting.status: candidate-level even when the group validates
individual_head_reporting.confirmation_effects: report exact patch estimates, cluster bootstrap intervals, and Holm sign values across the 16 candidate x direction family

mechanistic_boundary: Attribution and attention nominate heads; they are not causal evidence.
A validated multi-head patch supports candidate-set mediation at the CLS head-output node, not individual-head specificity or a directed path.
Individual candidate patches are reported separately and do not inherit the group random-set result.
The atlas concerns the replicated clean supervised promoter contrast only and cannot revive the failed local-context mechanism.
Exact GUE exclusion cannot rule out undocumented near-duplicate fine-tuning sequences.
